items.title: Paramount agrees to delay WBD acquisition to as late as June 2027 amid legal challenge
items.description: Paramount previously said it intended to complete its WBD acquisition by the end of September, but said Friday the agreement is a "significant win."

items.title: Moody's says 'unprecedented' AI spending threatens credit quality of Amazon, Meta, Alphabet and others
items.description: Moody's said AI spending is forcing even the world's most cash-rich corporations to lean heavily on debt, stock sales and off-balance-sheet moves.

items.title: Trump defends DOJ subpoenas of NY Times reporters; Google also was targeted
items.description: The DOJ is investigating the leak to The New York Times of security concerns about President Donald Trump's new Air Force One plane, donated by Qatar.

items.title: Musk's bad week: Tesla suffers worst slump since 2022, SpaceX drops ahead of Starship test flight
items.description: Tesla shares plunged almost 18% this week after the company missed on earnings and turned cash flow negative.

items.title: Bond market anxiety is growing over AI capex budgets
items.description: Google, Amazon and Meta are seeing credit spreads widen as fixed-income investors demand more reward on companies they lend to.

items.title: Treasury yields slide as oil prices fall amid hopes for new U.S.-Iran peace talks
items.description: U.S. Treasury yields slid on Friday as oil prices dropped following a report that Pakistan is ​exploring a way to restart peace talks between the U.S. and Iran.

items.title: Strait of Hormuz traffic may not return to normal for 12 months or more, according to prediction markets
items.description: Kalshi traders give less than 50% odds that the key maritime passageway will fully reopen by July 2027.

items.title: CDC says massive cyclospora outbreak is now in nine states
items.description: The four newly linked states — Illinois, Kansas, Oklahoma and Pennsylvania — join Indiana, Kentucky, Ohio, West Virginia and hard-hit Michigan.

items.title: 1 hyperscaler megacap down, 3 to go. Alphabet raises the stakes on AI spending
items.description: "Capex trends are going to be the number one focus," Club portfolio director Jeff Marks said Friday ahead of next week's Big Tech earnings.

items.title: Trump threatens EU with 'substantial TARIFF' for 'ROBBING' U.S. tech giants
items.description: Trump on Truth Social railed against the European Union's new fine on Google and prior penalties against U.S. tech giants Apple, Meta and Amazon.

items.title: Oil falls on report Pakistan is pushing for new U.S.-Iran talks with China's backing
items.description: Oil prices dropped by around 3% on Friday, but remained on track for a weekly jump of 10% as the U.S.-Iran war continued to escalate.

items.title: Trump considers ‘massive attack’ on Iran; Pakistan reportedly seeks to restart stalled peace talks
items.description: The president told Axios he was considering an operation "bigger than ever before" before Reuters reported Pakistan is seeking to restart peace talks.

items.title: Oil shipments are under attack on multiple fronts as fighting escalates in Red Sea, Hormuz and Black Sea
items.description: More than 60 commercial ships have been attacked in the Persian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz and Gulf of Oman since March 1.

items.title: Why bond investors are pushing up some of your interest rates
items.description: Many types of consumer loans like mortgages peg their interest rate to the yield on 10-year Treasury bonds, which has been moving higher.

items.title: Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta warn against 'premature restrictions' of open-weight models
items.description: Chinese open-weight models are gaining steam against leading offerings from American companies. OpenAI and Anthropic did not sign the letter.

items.title: Trader who successfully shorted Tesla into earnings now sets sights on this high flyer
items.description: The bearish Tesla set-up we flagged ahead of Wednesday's report has delivered most of what it can.

items.title: Anthropic's new AI model rivals Fable 5 and is cheaper as businesses fret about costs
items.description: Anthropic said Claude Opus 5 is its best performing and its most cost-effective offering.

items.title: Pentagon lowers official Iran war death toll, omitting four killed this month
items.description: The Pentagon lowered its official Iran war death toll to 14 from 18, removing four service members killed this month.

items.title: Why Costco keeps gas prices so low—it's 'straight out of the retail playbook,' expert says
items.description: Higher gas prices are driving record demand for Costco's gas stations as more Americans look to save at the pump.

items.title: Oracle signs 10-year software contract with Pentagon worth up to $7 billion
items.description: Oracle will supply on-premises software to the U.S. Department of Defense.
